fixes.what: Wrap or scope the canopy layer image preloads with a `not (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` condition, or preload `canopy-L2.webp` / `canopy-L3.webp` only on desktop if needed, and ensure `canopy-L0`/`canopy-L1` preloads also run under reduced motion since the canopy still renders on screen 1.
fixes.why: Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the canopy layers still render on the first screen, so skipping their preload delays the bottom foliage paint.

fixes.what: In ` ghostObserver`, check initial intersection state synchronously or trigger `syncTab(true)` immediately on first observation rather than waiting 700ms for `settleSoon` when `#inquire` is already in view (e.g., on direct `#inquire` hash load).
fixes.why: Landing directly on `index.html#inquire` leaves the `hww-tab` in the tab order for up to 700ms before the settle timer fires.

fixes.what: In `scrollToEl()`, pass `immediate: true` to `lenis.scrollTo` when `reduced || userPaused` is true (currently `lenis` is destroyed when paused, but if ever called during a transition, guarding duration with `reduced || userPaused ? 0 : 1.4` is safer).
fixes.why: Defensive guard so smooth scroll duration never runs if reduced-motion state flips mid-action.
